items.html: *Know that at the time of the Ibur of ZON in the upper Ima, ZA was then in the aspect of VAK alone, and the Nukva in the aspect of a single point included of ten, which is the aspect of the Malchut within her alone. And then, through the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin, the aspect of ZA grew until he was completed to ten Sefirot, as is known.
